{{Quote|My ship!|Wat Tambor, as TA-175 leaves him behind on Ryloth|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>}}
A '''''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle''' was owned by [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], who brought the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] along when he [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|invaded]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Tambor's [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]], [[TA-175/Legends|TA-175]], escaped from [[Lessu City/Legends|Lessu]] aboard the shuttle when [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] assaulted the [[Capital/Legends|capital]], leaving Tambor behind on Ryloth to become a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] of war.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" />
